Stripe's official rate-limit docs say the global limit is 100 requests per second in live mode and 25 in sandbox. In general, rate limits are measured in API requests per second, per Stripe account. Individual endpoints default to 25 requests per second, and Stripe may increase rate limits for specific accounts based on usage.

Some endpoints have their own limits. The Files API allows 20 reads and 20 writes per second, and the Search API allows 20 reads per second. The Payouts create call is capped at 15 requests per second. Meter events in live mode have a separate limit of 1000 calls per second per account, but in sandbox they count toward the basic limit.

Sources differ on wording. Stripe's own rate-limit doc uses "requests" and "operations" interchangeably. A Stripe support page describes the live limit as 100 parallel requests per second, and a third-party guide describes it as 100 read and 100 write operations. The official docs are the most reliable reference here. A Ghost commit from 2025 also cites the 100/25 figures, but it is a code comment rather than an authoritative source.

content.text:
Stripe's rate-limit docs give these defaults. I couldn't open the page directly because the fetch was refused, so these figures come from search-result summaries of it. Check them against the page before you rely on them.

**Global limits (per Stripe account)**
- **Live mode:** 100 requests per second
- **Sandbox:** 25 requests per second

**Per-endpoint limits**
- **Most endpoints:** 25 requests per second by default.
- **Files API:** 20 reads and 20 writes per second.
- **Search API:** 20 reads per second.
- **Payouts create:** 15 requests per second.
- **Meter events (live mode):** 1,000 calls per second per account. In sandbox they count toward the basic limit.

Stripe may raise the limits for specific accounts based on usage.

Other sources word the live limit differently. A Stripe support page calls it "100 parallel requests per second", and a third-party guide describes it as 100 read and 100 write operations. The official docs are the more reliable reference.

Sources:
- [Stripe: Rate limits](https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits)
- [Stripe Support: rate_limit error](https://support.stripe.com/questions/rate-limit-error)
- [Stripe Support: rate limit error on bulk API requests](https://support.stripe.com/questions/rate-limit-error-when-creating-bulk-api-requests)
